What degraded

  • Shipped at the round cap at 6.89, under round 2's 7.7 rung and the 8.0 bar; the art median 6.2 is under the 8.5 craft floor, which stands down at the cap.
  • Not merged. main's CI is red on the grid watch instrument (gridwatch_pagecheck exit 3, the large load queue reading stopped at 2026-08), the same cause holding the November 1st to 3rd pull requests. This pull request carries all four days.
  • The flow critic's stroke motif, the jack's rim light, one sky hue on frames 3, 4 and 7, and lit brass accent props were not done and are queued.
  • Frame 6's computed 45.5 percent came off the frame after the round cap because the published-work gate refused it; the gauge carries the share wordlessly and the hook says a little under half.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Permian Resources names two AI tools and prints no measured result for either, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

AI for runtime. The record runtimes went to power and compression.

Permian Resources named two AI tools in its November 4th release. An artificial lift monitor is there to increase runtime. A second feeds its subsurface data to large language models.

Third quarter output was 457,528 barrels of oil equivalent a day. The release prints no measured result for either AI tool.

Its 2025 annual report put about 67% of its net leasehold in Texas. Neither filing says which wells the monitor watches. On May 21st the Texas Tribune reported the Railroad Commission said it was not aware of any use of AI by oil and gas companies. The same article quoted experts and analysts saying AI is reshaping how Permian operators handle produced water.

The Commission meets next on November 17th. How much of those record runtimes is the monitor's?

#DelawareBasin #PermianBasin #RailroadCommission

Notes

NOT MERGED. main's CI is red on the grid watch instrument: gridwatch_pagecheck exits 3 because the large load queue reading stopped at 2026-08, from a queue filename the cron-lane collector builds with a year ERCOT doesn't publish, and November 1st is missing from the series. The one action that clears it is a maintainer fix to scripts/gridwatch/queue_collect.py's report filename; once main is green, merging this pull request lands November 1st to 4th together. The deck images in this email point at the run branch. Record. Re-verified 166 items across November 4th and 5th against their sources, with notes written per decision; the screwworm item's county count and zone moved from the USDA source. www.utsouthwestern.edu and www.utep.edu failed TLS again; tx-2026-0102 and tx-2026-0228 were confirmed on alternate primary pages and tx-2026-0227 declares www.utep.edu blocks_every_client, checked November 5th. Admitted tx-2026-0240, Permian Resources' AI artificial lift monitoring and language model use, on its SEC filing. Its title was corrected at ship to name the artificial lift and no pump type. Deck. Carousel no. 68 shipped at the round cap at 6.89 (rounds 6.614, 6.60, 6.89). Round 2 found one hard fail, the cover's "pump jack" over a claim naming only an artificial lift monitoring system, repaired on the cover, the web edition and the record title. The judges' standing notes: the jack is an unrimmed silhouette on 1, 4 and 9, frame 7's pipe ends read as coins, frame 5's rods as a bar chart, frame 3 has a dead left half. Permissions. prompt_audit measured 1,783 calls and listed 83 that waited, the longest 19.8 seconds on a SendMessage call, all Agent, SendMessage and Bash calls that resolved with nobody present (the queue's prompt-audit-counts-agent-latency item), no dialog. No-stall hook: armed at 2026-11-05T05:03:48Z, judged the session unattended from the start (CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ATTENDED=0 from the host), refused nothing. Machine. The weekly pass is not due (last November 3rd); six items queued.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck did NOT merge, so nothing here is on main and there is nothing to post. The links resolve against the run branch for as long as it exists.
